response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in routing, navigation, or distributed data pipelines — key requirements for the role. His DLang and Node.js work shows systems-level capability, but the absence of proven expertise in routing tiling, real-time traffic integration, or low-latency geospatial data processing raises significant gaps.
strengths: Built and maintained open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world usage
Demonstrated systems-level programming with DLang, asynchronous I/O, and low-latency services
Strong track record of cross-stack adaptability and technical leadership across diverse domains
concerns: No demonstrated professional experience with C++ or Rust in production routing or navigation systems
Lacks explicit experience with routing tile generation, map data optimization, or global data pipeline latency reduction
Minimal evidence of distributed systems work (fault tolerance, consistency, service discovery) in geospatial context
